question: Which of the following institutions’ researchers will collaborate with the Mobile Payment Forum of India to develop voice-based solutions for digital transactions?
solution:
The correct answer is__** IIT Madras.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Researchers from the** Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Madras** will work with members of the **Mobile Payment Forum of India (MPFI) **to develop **voice-based solutions** in several **vernacular languages** in order to increase the country's adoption of **digital money transactions.**
 
• According to Indian government figures, there are more than **100 million active **Unified Payments Interface (UPI) users every month.
 
• These initiatives are being taken up by MPFI towards bringing **500 million active users by 2025.**
 
• **IIT Madras**:
 
 
• It is located in **Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.** 
 
• **Prof. Humayun Kabir**, Union Minister for Scientific Research and Cultural Affairs, formally inaugurated the Institute in **1959.**
 
 
 
• **Mobile Payment Forum of India**:__
 
 
• The Mobile Payment Forum of India (MPFI) is a **think tank founded in 2006** by the** joint initiative** of the **Institute for Development and Research in Banking Technology (IDRBT)**, **Hyderabad and Rural Technology Business Incubator (RTBI), IIT Madras **in **2006.**
